testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle camera autosave for an inactive copied view: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1016:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle camera autosave for an inactive copied view ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user copies the Primary view representation as BrowserView and leaves Primary active ✔ And an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Primary is the active view representation ✔ And an inactive copied view representation exists ✔ And its camera autosave option is checked ✔ When the user opens the copied view's context menu and expands Camera View ✔ Then Save Current Camera is unavailable ✔ And Restore Saved Camera is available ✔ And Autosave Camera is checked ✔ When the user chooses Autosave Camera ✔ And the user reopens the Camera View submenu ✔ Then Autosave Camera is unchecked ✔ When the user chooses Autosave Camera again ✔ And the user reopens the Camera View submenu ✔ Then Autosave Camera is checked ✔ And the viewport remains empty ✔ When the user dismisses the menus ✔ Then Primary remains the active view
